_comment: Every way a value can fail to be a number, on components that ARE enabled.
Carrier types most GraphQL scalars as String and spells 'missing' as the
literal string "None" (never JSON null), so all four shapes appear:
eheat   -> numeric STRINGS: readable, two rows.
cooling -> "None" kWh, null dollars: no rows at all.
fan     -> kWh present, dollars field ABSENT from the object: one row.
hpheat  -> non-numeric junk kWh, valid dollars: one row.
A gap stays a gap -- none of these may become a zero (CLAUDE.md rule 1).
